text: Callum's driving test is booked for 2 November 2026. Third attempt and he's properly nervous about it. Text him good luck the night before.
anan starts new job at the council sometime next week. ask how first day went
Bethany's daughter Mabel starts reception in September 2027, they spent all weekend looking round schools. Mabel's obsessed with dinosaurs at the moment.

Tiago is retiring at the end of the month after 31 years at the depot, can't quite believe it. Leaving do is Friday the 30th at the Crown, his wife and both daughters are coming. He wants to do a bit of fishing and finally get the allotment sorted. Need to chip in for the collection, ask Sana who's sorting it.
Note to self. Alessia passed her grade eight piano, distinction apparently. Her mum was in tears telling me about it. Send her a card this week.
Siddharth - promoted to senior engineer, starts the new role early March. Wife Anjali expecting too, due over the summer. Big year for them.
My interview for the team lead role got moved off Thursday. Now sometime next week, still waiting on HR to confirm.
Jonah's A level results day is 13 August 2027 and he's already stressing about it lol
Fang mentioned her son Liam got into the county youth orchestra. Audition was last month. She's proper chuffed.
Eilidh's graduation ceremony has been called off because of the strikes, so they're doing a small thing at home on the 14th instead. I'm bringing the cake.

Long call with Natasha tonight. She's handed her notice in at the bank, last day is end of November, and she starts at a small design agency in January 2027. Terrified but excited. Her partner Mihai is being really supportive, he's picking up more of the school runs with their two. She said she'd love a decent leather notebook for the new job, hint hint. Must sort that before Christmas.
Pick up passport photos for the provisional licence form. Post office before Sat.
Shira's brother Tariq sat the bar exam in July, results out end of October. Ask Shira if he's heard anything.
Yusuf started at the new primary on Monday. Cried at the gate apparently but was fine by lunch. Zainab says he's already made a friend called Finn.
Imani - vegan, doesn't drink, works nights at the Royal. Really into bouldering.
Victor's leaving drinks moved to 2 December 2026, not the 28th. He's off to Lisbon for a new job early in the new year.
must ring Uncle Sunil re his retirement party, think its sometime mid Jan
Amy had her theory test this morning and passed!! Practical booked for March 2027. Congratulate her when I see her at netball.

Alina's audition for the conservatoire is 9 Feb 2027. She's practising four hours a day and barely sleeping, her mum says she's living on toast. Her teacher thinks she's ready but Alina doesn't believe it. Backup plan is a music degree at Glasgow. Check in on her end of next week.
SANTIAGO GOT THE JOB. The architecture firm one. Starts 1 December 2026.

Sana's dog Biscuit is having a lump removed on Tuesday and she's worried sick. Their eldest has GCSE mocks the same week too, so it's a lot. Her husband's away with work till Thursday. Offered to walk Biscuit after the op if she needs, she said she'd let me know.
lila first day at nursery tmrw. tadhg dropping her off, he's more nervous than she is
Mrs Hughes (Bethany's mum) is retiring from the school after 25 years at the end of the summer term 2027. They're planning a surprise do.
Ayesha and Tariq both graduating on 2 November 2026, same uni, different courses. Their parents are flying in from Karachi for it.
Need to revise for the CIPD exam over the summer. Book study leave before the rota goes out.
Nikolai Ito, goes by Nik, new starter in finance. Moved down from Leeds, has two cats. Supports Leeds United obviously.
Follow up with Callum about the driving test, it was Saturday and I never heard
Anan's probation review went well, he's being kept on permanently. His boss wants him leading the Manchester project from early March.

so Mihai was saying his daughter got her eleven plus results and she didn't get into the grammar so they're appealing but honestly she seems fine about it it's him and Natasha who are gutted remind me to ask him how the appeal goes sometime next month
Finn's 18th was last weekend. Still owe him a present. He's into vinyl, mentioned wanting the new Fontaines LP.
Zainab was made redundant on Friday. Thirty day consultation. She didn't want to talk much. Check in on her mid next week.

Bethany Lewis, PhD viva set for March 2027. Supervisor is Dr Moreau. She's anxious about who the external examiner will be and keeps rewriting chapter four. Thesis has to be submitted end of January. Said she'd kill for a weekend away once it's done, maybe a spa voucher when she passes.
jonah driving test cancelled AGAIN (examiner off sick). rebooked for end of the month
Mabel lost her first tooth today and is making a huge deal about the tooth fairy. Bethany asked if I knew any good swimming lessons near them.
Victor's wife Alessia starts maternity leave early December, baby due around Christmas. Ask Victor what they actually need, they've said no more clothes please.

Had coffee with Shira. She's going for the deputy head job at her school, interview sometime next week, and she's been up late every night prepping a presentation on behaviour policy. Her twins are both doing SATs in May 2027 so the timing isn't great. I should drop her a message the morning of the interview.
Remind me to send Imani the link for the nursing course open day, it's 14 November.
Grandad's 90th is 2 November 2026. Me and Mum are doing the food.
Tadhg O'Brien passed his electrician apprenticeship assessment. Starts as a fully qualified sparky at his uncle's firm next month.

Parents evening with Mrs Johnson about Yusuf. Reading has come on loads, maths a bit behind. She suggested the library reading challenge over the summer. Zainab and I agreed ten minutes a night. Next review sometime in early March. Also his class assembly is 27 November 2026 at 9am, don't forget to book the morning off.
Alina said her sister Amy has just started on the Deloitte grad scheme. Already hates the commute.
Liam's results for his Masters come out end of the month. Fingers crossed for a distinction, he worked so hard.
Ayesha: coeliac, birthday 19 March, loves anything Studio Ghibli.
Tiago's grandson starts uni in Edinburgh in September 2027 and Tiago keeps asking me about student loans. I should send him the gov page.
Gym tonight, then finish the cover letter for the Barros & Co role. Deadline end of the week.
finn didnt make the first team after trials. gutted. says hes going to keep training over the summer and go again
Sunil's daughter Anjali passed her driving test first time this morning!!! He was shaking on the phone lol. send congrats
Santiago Barros (Santi to everyone), Natasha's old uni friend, now head of product at a fintech. Into trail running, did UTMB last year.
Fang - ask about Liam's orchestra concert, sometime early December. Maybe get tickets for us both.
Eilidh started at the distillery today, first day was mostly safety training. She and Tadhg are moving up to Speyside end of the month to be closer to it.
Nothing much from the catch up with Anan, just work moans. He's fine.

Mihai's mum is having her hip op on 2 November 2026 and he's taking two weeks off to look after her. She lives on her own in Reading so he'll stay at hers. He's a bit worried because the last op had complications. Remind me to ask how it went.

Victor called. His son Jonah got the part of Fagin in the school production of Oliver! Auditioned last Tuesday, found out this morning. Shows are 10 to 12 March 2027. Jonah's buzzing but Victor reckons he's already panicking about learning all the lines. Get tickets for the Friday night, and text Jonah a well done before then.
Tariq passed his probation, goes onto the promotion track from early next year. Wants to do an MBA eventually.
Sana's leaving the NHS after 22 years! Retirement do is 12 December 2026 at Victoria Hall. Need to RSVP by end of the month.
Natasha said Mihai's struggling with the new manager at work, and his review is end of November. Don't bring it up unless he does.
Imani's sister Lila had her baby boy on Sunday, 7lb 2oz. Imani's an auntie for the first time and over the moon.
Book flights for March 2027.
Callum's mate Siddharth is taking the police entrance exam sometime next week. Callum asked if I'd help him with the maths bits, so I'm having him round Thursday at 7.

Alessia, quick one: her eldest Mabel starts secondary next September and they're touring schools over the next few weeks. She's stressed about the application deadline on 31 October. Her youngest has a cello exam in early March as well, poor thing.
